commit_message:
Make use of the flexible-array feature of C99, when available, to try to pacify -fsanitize=strict-bounds.  This check-in fixes the core. There is more yet to do in FTS3, RTREE, and in FTS5.

intro_commit_message:
Make use of the flexible-array feature of C99, when available, to try to pacify -fsanitize=strict-bounds.  This check-in fixes the core. There is more yet to do in FTS3, RTREE, and in FTS5.

fix_commit_message:
Fix an off-by-one error in the size computation of a vdbe-sorter. [forum:/forumpost/c1cc8b057a|Forum post c1cc8b057a]. Problem introduced by checkin [d4307a0d43f42e96].

FossilOrigin-Name: 8b7a7fcf62e5c2742c243808fa482472954f2b4aae0bc7ae513bc07065c93737
agent_reasoning: The fix commit changes a single call site in src/vdbesort.c: `szKeyInfo = SZ_KEYINFO(pCsr->pKeyInfo->nKeyField+1);` becomes `szKeyInfo = SZ_KEYINFO(pCsr->pKeyInfo->nKeyField);`. This removes the stray `+1` that caused an over-read past the end of the source KeyInfo struct during memcpy. I applied exactly this one-line edit, matching the fix commit, with no other changes.
